name: review-gate-advisory-convergence
title: Local review gate cannot converge under advisory-mode prism findings
description: The local review gate blocks on any finding, but the configured providers emit observations across eight focus categories, so a receipt with no real defects never becomes clean and this repository's remote lane is absent by design.
creator: sdelmas
notes:
2026-08-09: PARKED. Filed upstream, not fixable here. Upstream 08-07-local-finding-rebuttal-channel covers the disposition channel and PR #402 already shipped _local_outstanding, which this repo's 0.64.3 predates. The non-convergence failure mode and the severity/category requirement were appended upstream in PR #406. Status stays planning because the task was never started -- no branch, no task.py start; parking is carried by the PARKED: title prefix plus blocked/blockedOn, per the work-loop inventory convention. 2026-08-15: blockedOn rewritten -- the original text said the task resumes on a refresh carrying a category-aware gate, which understated what had already landed. Three of four requirements are now met; see blockedOn for the file and line evidence. Still parked.
2026-08-20: Unparked by owner directive (unpark-all); park rationale preserved here. Previous blockedOn: Half-arrived: the rebuttal channel this task waited on has shipped, the category-aware gate has not. Shipped and verified in the vendored copy on 2026-08-15 -- scripts/sd-ai-command-pack-review.py:1790 accepts --local-disposition '<id>=rebutted', and scripts/sd-ai-command-pack-review-local.py:1956 gates on outstanding findings only, so a rebutted finding no longer blocks. That satisfies requirements 1, 2 and 4. Requirement 3 remains: the gate decision still cannot use a finding's severity or category, only the actionable boolean at scripts/sd-ai-command-pack-review-local.py:900-905. Resumes on a pack refresh carrying severity/category into the gate decision. Verify against review-local.py itself, not upstream task status: upstream 08-07-local-finding-rebuttal-channel is still PARKED: with all five acceptance criteria unchecked even though its functionality shipped. Evidence trail: platypeeps/sd-ai-command-pack#406.
2026-08-24: Re-checked, no movement since 2026-08-20 -- and none is coming from refreshes alone. sd-ai-command-pack-review-local.py is byte-identical across every cached release 0.71.1 through 0.71.33 and to the copy in force at ~/.agents/bin (sha256 9efca3af9030d4af01a58762569fdd2345a26d2d23cb771ba4e98dd313200ead), while this repository took three refreshes in August (0.71.33, 0.71.38, 0.71.45). Requirement 3 and the PR #99 miscitation ground remain open; the unblock needs the upstream change made, not another refresh. prd.md's BLOCKED header was rewritten because it still quoted the pre-#402 gate. relatedFiles are still the dangling set -- implement.md step 0.1 owns that fix, so it was left alone here.
2026-08-25: Re-parked after the 0.71.48 rollout merged (ten PRs, this repository at e4330308). Criteria 1-5 are met; criterion 6 is blocked on pack-owned ground and cannot close here, so in_progress was misreporting it as work in flight. prd.md gained a dated section correcting the provider-switch claim that the prism patches had been retired -- they were rebuilt on the sdelmas/prism fork and the fleet runs that binary -- and recording a fifth prism defect: NeedsChunking gates on a 100 KB ChunkThreshold rather than on ChunkMaxBytes, so sub-100 KB deltas are never chunked. That is why scripts/prism-chunked-review.py stays despite both defects in its own docstring being fixed.
2026-08-25: UNPARKED and all six criteria met. Criterion 6 closed by a third PR #70 replay reaching remoteGate {state: eligible, reason: local-findings-accepted}, outstanding 0, accepted 2, advisory 3, one provider attempt, no round-extension; receipt 01bc26a47bed8804. Two prerequisites had to be cleared first. The machine install at ~/.agents/bin was at pack 0.71.39 with a review-local.py byte-identical to 0.71.33 and zero occurrences of 'accepted' -- sd-machine-install moved it to 0.71.51 (117 files). And the gito adapter passes --vs <base> but never the head, so gito compares the base against the working tree; run from main it produced 15 findings of which 14 cited files outside PR #70's diff entirely. Filed as pack 08-25-gito-adapter-drops-head (PR #542) -- a sixth provider defect of the same silent shape. The faithful range was rebuilt by rebasing PR #70's nine commits onto an overlay base carrying today's review.json, giving a diff identical to c3ec5f64...2880186 and the same contentDigest 797508f1d5e0. Both blocking findings verified true and both were genuine defects introduced by the change, so the criterion's own failure condition fired: fixed on main in PR #150, then accepted on the frozen head with the fix named in each reason. Open follow-ons: PR #150 and PR #542 are both unmerged, and the run exercised gito only -- prism-chunked was never selected.
